The plate spans roughly 355 px across. If it is a 26 cm dinner plate, that is about 13.6 px per cm.

The sausage measures roughly 140 px long, which is about 10 cm, and about 55 px wide, which is about 4 cm. That is a fairly thick sausage, probably a pork sausage or bratwurst. A volume of roughly π × 2² × 10 × 0.8 gives about 100 cm³, so I estimate about 80-90 g. Cooked pork sausage runs about 300 kcal per 100 g, so this one comes to roughly 250 kcal.
